system.description:
Ancient draconic blood runs through your line — distant, potent, and hungry for power.

  • Bloodline Ability (1st): Choose one damage type tied to a dragon colour (fire, cold, lightning, acid, or poison). Gain Resistance 5 to that type. Your AC increases by 1 permanently as scales occasionally emerge under your skin. You speak and understand Draconic and have advantage on Charisma checks against dragons and dragon-blooded creatures.
  • Bloodline Awakening (15th): Once per day, unleash your ancestor's aura for 1 minute — creatures within 30ft make a Will save or are frightened. Your chosen damage type ignores resistance while active.
